title: UCKK Publication
role: Optional governed publication of selected private or local kOA Mediatheque records to the online UCKK Mediatheque and Moodle learning surfaces.

publication_model.authorization: Publication Gateway allow decision with resolved rights, restrictions, consent, purpose, audience, destination, and expiry.
publication_model.idempotency: A package and destination mapping use a stable idempotency key for retry-safe publication.
publication_model.remote_mapping: Remote course, section, activity, repository, collection, or other Moodle target identifiers remain destination references.
publication_model.remote_result: A validated publication receipt is attached to local export history.
publication_model.remote_deletion: No deletion or revocation guarantee is assumed unless the UCKK endpoint explicitly supports and acknowledges it.

prohibited_operations: implicit publication of all local media
remote mutation without an authorized package
replacement of local record identity by a remote identifier
treating UCKK acknowledgement as proof of local rights or semantic truth
using UCKK as a required dependency for local Mediatheque operation

data_transfer.content_transfer: Only selected and authorized renditions or originals declared by the publication package.
data_transfer.metadata_transfer: Only fields mapped and allowed for the declared destination and audience.
data_transfer.credentials: Resolved from a dedicated secret store and never embedded in media records or packages.

offline_behavior.package_creation: permitted only while authorization and source state remain verifiable locally
offline_behavior.success_state: not recorded until a remote receipt is validated
offline_behavior.retry: bounded, idempotent, and subject to authorization expiry and source-version consistency

failure_model.authentication_failure: block transmission and preserve the authorized package in a protected queued or failed state
failure_model.destination_unavailable: queue or fail according to retry policy without affecting local media availability
failure_model.partial_publication: record per-item outcomes and require review before retrying failed items
failure_model.rights_or_authorization_change: cancel pending transmission and require a new decision
failure_model.ambiguous_remote_result: record unknown outcome and reconcile by idempotency key before retry

security_and_audit.credential_scope: least privilege for the declared UCKK destination operations

compatibility.shared_mediatheque_frame: Both sides implement the declared shared Mediatheque frame or a validated compatible version; this does not create shared authority, storage, identity, access control, or lifecycle.
compatibility.unsupported_destination_behavior: block the unsupported mapping; do not silently discard fields or restrictions
compatibility.import: Inbound retrieval and local acceptance are implemented by the separate uckk-import integration; neither direction implies background synchronization.
